summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Bell Arthur, an unincorporated community and census-designated place in Pitt County, North Carolina. It gives the population from the 2010 census and notes the community's post office and ZIP code. The note also records an alternate name, Bellarthur.
one_line: Bell Arthur is an unincorporated community and census-designated place in Pitt County, North Carolina, with a 2010 population of 466.
key_facts: Bell Arthur is an unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP) in Pitt County, North Carolina, United States.
Bell Arthur is also known as Bellarthur.
The population of Bell Arthur was 466 as of the 2010 census.
Bell Arthur has a post office with ZIP code 27811.
